market.question: Will Venezuelan crude oil production reach 1.4m barrels per day in 2026?

assessment.reasoning: Venezuela crude production was 1,021 kb/d Feb 2026 and rose to ~1,095 kb/d in March; April exports reached 1.23m bpd (7-yr high). Going from ~1.1m production to 1.4m bpd represents ~27% additional growth, with infrastructure decay capping recovery; analysts call current 'recovery' temporary. Reaching 1.4m bpd in any single 2026 month is unlikely.
assessment.key_uncertainty: US sanctions waivers and Chevron/PDVSA developments could accelerate recovery faster than expected.
